_meta.description: Called by the 'Appraisal Review Extractor' Copilot Studio agent. Accepts an appraisal review PDF (as a file input, not an HTTP upload — see trigger notes), extracts 17 credit-risk data points via an AI Builder prompt, appends one row to the shared Appraisal Review Tracker workbook, and returns a link plus a summary to the agent.
_meta.invokedBy: Appraisal Review Extractor (Copilot Studio agent), via InvokeFlowAction — not called over HTTP by other flows/agents
connectors: AI Builder (shared_aibuilder) — Predict with a custom Prompt (see Deployment Configuration below)
Excel Online (Business) (shared_excelonlinebusiness) — Add a row into a table
SharePoint (shared_sharepointonline) — used once at setup time to provision the tracker file; not called per run
costNotes: No Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Document Intelligence, or Azure Function is provisioned for this tool — extraction runs entirely on the AI Builder prompt included with the team's Power Platform/Copilot Studio capacity, so the only new consumption is AI Builder credits per PDF processed.

The tracker's SharePoint sharing link is computed once at deployment time and passed in as a parameter (trackerFileUrl) rather than requested from SharePoint on every run — saves one API call per extraction and avoids link-churn.
One shared, ever-growing tracker workbook is used instead of copying the template per request, so there is no per-run file-copy cost and no runaway document sprawl in SharePoint.
The agent enforces a 15 MB / 40-page cap before calling this flow (see agent/appraisal-agent-instructions.md), so this flow never spends AI Builder credits on an oversized or clearly-invalid upload.

trigger.description: Native 'When Copilot Studio calls a flow' trigger. No Premium HTTP Request trigger is used, so this flow does not require a Power Automate Premium license — only the connectors below (Excel Online (Business) and SharePoint are standard; AI Builder consumption is billed separately via AI Builder credits).

fileContent.description: The appraisal review PDF, passed as a File-type input from the agent's Attachment question (topic.AppraisalFile).

outputs.description: Configured on the trigger's Outputs panel in the designer (see DEPLOYMENT.md) — each output is bound to an expression pointing at the corresponding Compose action below.

Extract_With_AI_Builder.description: Calls the custom AI Builder Prompt 'Appraisal Review Field Extraction' (created once in AI Builder > Prompts, see DEPLOYMENT.md). The prompt takes the PDF as a File input variable and returns structured JSON matching the schema in agent/appraisal-agent-instructions.md — no separate OCR step or Azure Document Intelligence resource is needed for machine-readable PDFs.

Add_Row_To_Tracker.description: Appends one row to the AppraisalReviewData table in the single shared tracker workbook (parameters.trackerSiteUrl / parameters.trackerFileId — provisioned once from templates/Appraisal-Review-Tracker-Template.xlsx, see DEPLOYMENT.md). No new file is created per run.

Build_Row_Summary.inputs: @concat(coalesce(body('Parse_Extraction_Result')?['streetAddress'], 'Address not stated'), ', ', coalesce(body('Parse_Extraction_Result')?['city'], '?'), ', ', coalesce(body('Parse_Extraction_Result')?['state'], '?'), ' — ', coalesce(body('Parse_Extraction_Result')?['occupancyType'], 'occupancy not stated'), ', collateral value ', if(equals(body('Parse_Extraction_Result')?['collateralAnalysisValue'], null), 'not stated', concat('$', string(body('Parse_Extraction_Result')?['collateralAnalysisValue']))))

Handle_Extraction_Failure.description: Fires if either the AI Builder prompt call or the JSON parse fails — most commonly a scanned/non-OCR'd PDF the prompt could not read, or a malformed prompt response.

inputs.errorMessage: @coalesce(actions('Extract_With_AI_Builder')?['error']?['message'], 'The document could not be read. It may be a scanned image without a text layer, or in an unsupported format.')
inputs.extractionNotes: Extraction failed — no row was added to the tracker.

aiBuilderPromptId.description: GUID of the 'Appraisal Review Field Extraction' AI Builder Prompt, created once per environment (see DEPLOYMENT.md).

trackerDriveId.description: Drive (document library) ID that holds the single shared tracker workbook.

trackerFileId.description: File ID of the tracker workbook provisioned once from templates/Appraisal-Review-Tracker-Template.xlsx.

trackerFileUrl.description: Static sharing link to the tracker workbook, generated once at setup time and reused on every run (see costNotes above).
